calibration.source_text:
The exported file MUST have the same SHA-256 checksum as the source.

## Validation

- The SHA-256 value in the export manifest equals the source file's SHA-256 value.

rules.text: The exported file MUST have the same SHA-256 checksum as the source.

checks.text: The SHA-256 value in the export manifest equals the source file's SHA-256 value.

calibration.source_text:
Only clients with a valid account credential MAY access the archive.

## Security Tests

- Submit a request with a valid credential and verify that the archive returns 200; submit an unknown credential and verify that it returns 403.

rules.text: Only clients with a valid account credential MAY access the archive.

checks.text: Submit a request with a valid credential and verify that the archive returns 200; submit an unknown credential and verify that it returns 403.

calibration.source_text:

## Acceptance Checks

- Assert that the operation makes no more than four attempts.
